in_text_mentions: hough there is no immunological problem, individuals with HSAN IV have definite problems in healing of ectodermal structures – skin and bone. Fractures are slow to heal and large weight bearing joints appear particularly susceptible to repeated trauma and frequently go on to the development of Charcot joints and osteomyelitis (Figure 5). Speech is usually clear. Although hypotonia and delayed developmental milestones are frequent in the early years, strength and tone normalize with age. However, there can be severe learning problems. Hyperactivity and emotional lability are common [1,3,12,56].
